entries.product: RISフィニッシュエース (RIS Finish Ace)
entries.type: one-component trowel-applied high-performance PAE polymer-cement section repair mortar, fast-hardening, thick-build (polymer premixed, add water only)

source.version: Catalog T-297 SZ1, first issued Oct 2020, revised Mar 2022 (K2)

values.class: Meets NEXCO 'Structure Construction Management Guidelines' quality standard for trowel-applied section repair materials (左官工法による断面修復材の品質規格); no EN 1504-3 class stated
values.flexural: 3.2 / 4.5 / 5.2 / 6.1 N/mm² (4 h / 1 d / 7 d / 28 d; one example)
values.adhesion: 1.5 N/mm² (7 d) / 2.0 N/mm² (28 d) (JIS A 6909; one example)
values.thickness: standard single-layer thickness 5–40 mm; up to 40 mm per layer on walls and 30 mm per layer on ceilings
values.consumption: 17.5 kg/m² at 10 mm thickness (1,750 kg per m³; one 12.5 kg bag ≈ 0.7 m² at 10 mm, ≈ 7 L of mortar)
values.water: 2.1 kg water per 12.5 kg bag (294 kg water per 1,750 kg product per m³)
values.pot_life: setting (hardening) time 50 min at 20 °C (one example); usable time depends on temperature and humidity — trial mix required
values.overcoat: when the previous layer has fully hardened (≥ 6 h at 5 °C, ≥ 3 h at 20 °C, ≥ 2 h at 30 °C) apply RIS211E primer (3× diluted, 150 g/m²) before the next layer
values.application_temp: stop work or provide suitable heat protection when the outdoor air temperature is 3 °C or below (no range stated)

compressive.label: 40.5 N/mm² (28 d, JIS A 1171, one example)

entries.notes: Japanese NEXCO-spec PAE polymer-cement mortar, not EN 1504-3 classified; 28-d strength (40.5 N/mm²) is below the R4 threshold (≥ 45 N/mm²), so it is not an R4 equivalent. Chosen over Denka's general-purpose RIS321エース (10–20 mm per layer) because its 5–40 mm single-layer range matches BIS-5/40. Catalog table columns are scrambled in the PDF text; age assignment (4 h → 28 d) checked against Denka's technical data Dec 2016 (≈22 / 31 / 41 N/mm² at 1 / 7 / 28 d, 20 °C). Shelf life not printed (store like cement: dry, cool, dark). Primer RIS211E (EVA) and rebar paste RIS防錆パウダー + RIS111 form the system. Published list price 310 JPY/kg (product page). Denka Group alternative in South-East Asia: Estopatch ST (Denka Construction Solutions Malaysia, ex-ESTOP) — single-component polymer-modified structural repair mortar, 25 / 53 N/mm² at 1 / 28 d (ASTM C942, w/p 0.11), flexural 9 N/mm², slant shear 23 N/mm² (BS 6319), min. 5 mm, up to 20–25 mm vertical, 2.5–3.0 L water per 25 kg, ≈ 1.2 m² per bag at 10 mm (TDS https://www.denka-cs.com/storage/products/pdfs/Estopatch_ST_-_Data_Sheet_-_211107.pdf); no EN 1504-3 class either.

entries.type: polymer-cement nitrite-type rebar rust-prevention paste: redispersible-powder-resin premix mixed on site with RIS111 (25 % lithium-nitrite solution), brush-applied to rebar

source.version: Catalog file dated 2017.12 (edition line in the text read as 2015.10); RIS111 catalog Jan 2016 (K4) used for RIS111 data

values.class: Rebar rust-prevention material meeting the NEXCO Structure Construction Management Guidelines (Table 3-5-1, H22.7) performance items — rust-prevention rate treated section 94 % (criterion ≥ 50 %), untreated section 54 % (≥ −10 %), bond to rebar 15.3 N/mm² (≥ 7.8 N/mm²), alkali resistance no abnormality (tested by Japan Paint Inspection Association, West Branch); JR West quality standard claimed; no EN 1504-7
values.components: 2: RIS防錆パウダー (12.5 kg powder) + RIS111 (5.0 kg lithium-nitrite solution) mixed on site into a paste
values.adhesion: bond to concrete 1.8 N/mm² (7 d) / 2.1 N/mm² (28 d); bond to repair mortar 1.6 / 1.9 N/mm² (JIS A 1171, 20 °C, 80 % r.h.; one example)
values.consumption: 600–900 g/m² of rebar surface (standard 750 g/m²), brush application
values.water: no water — 12.5 kg powder + 5.0 kg RIS111 (1,350 kg powder + 540 kg RIS111 per m³ of paste)
values.packaging: RIS防錆パウダー 12.5 kg paper bag; RIS111 5 kg and 20 kg cans

adhesion.label: 2.1 N/mm² to concrete (28 d, JIS A 1171 pull-off)

entries.notes: Two-part system (powder + lithium-nitrite solution), not a one-component product and not a bond coat: Denka primes the concrete with the EVA primer RIS211E (3× diluted) instead. Corrosion inhibition is by nitrite (RIS111), not by alkalinity alone. Number of coats, layer thickness, pot life, waiting time, application temperature and shelf life are not printed (property data at 5/20/30 °C; RIS111 stored above 0 °C in a cool dark place). Do not spray. List prices: powder 400 JPY/kg, RIS111 5,600 JPY/kg (20 kg). Denka Construction Solutions Malaysia lists no cementitious rebar primer (its Estobond Acryl is an acrylic bonding emulsion and Estotect Zincrich a solvent-free zinc-modified epoxy coating for steel/linings).

entries.notes: Denka has no crystalline repair mortar; entered as the nearest corresponding product for sealing water-bearing cracks, construction joints and joints (as the other brands' plug mortars in this slot). Setting time 3 min 10 s (strength specimens) / 2 min 50 s (bond specimens), so no 30-min working time; usable time not printed. Bond shear strength 1.5 (1 d) / 2.5 (28 d) N/mm² (push-out, steel ring); water permeation 0 g at 1/7/28 d (JIS A 1404). The 2015 catalog gives 3.1 / 5.0 / 14.9 / 42.6 N/mm² (1 h / 3 h / 1 d / 28 d, 20 °C, 80 % r.h.) for TYPE-3 — the 2022 technical data are used here. List price 550 JPY/kg. Denka Group alternative in South-East Asia: Estop Water Plug (Denka Construction Solutions Malaysia) — chloride-free hydraulic plugging cement, hardening < 180 s at 25 °C, > 10 / 13 / 23 / 35 N/mm² at 30 min / 1 d / 3 d / 28 d (BS 6319-2), w/p 0.31, 5 kg tin ≈ 2.5 L (TDS code 050304, https://www.denka-cs.com/storage/products/pdfs/Estop_Waterplug_-_Data_Sheet_-_050304.pdf).

entries.notes: Denka's water-stop cement comes in TYPE-0 (dry powder pressed in, instant), TYPE-100 (instant on water contact), TYPE-1 and TYPE-3 (fast-setting water stop; TYPE-3 with higher adhesion and water-stopping), and TYPE-10/-20/-B20/-U1 for product repair. TYPE-3 chosen because Denka publishes its own technical data (2022) and it corresponds to a ~2-min plugging mortar. Bond shear strength 1.5 (1 d) / 2.3 (7 d) / 2.5 (28 d) N/mm²; length change air-dry −0.009 % at 28 d; water permeation 0 g (JIS A 1404). Usable time, application temperature and shelf life are not printed (cement-based, store dry and use promptly). Not swellable in the sense of an expanding plug; described as non-shrink. Denka Group alternative in South-East Asia: Estop Water Plug (Denka Construction Solutions Malaysia) — chloride-free hydraulic plugging cement, hardening < 180 s at 25 °C, > 10 / 13 / 23 / 35 N/mm² at 30 min / 1 d / 3 d / 28 d (BS 6319-2), w/p 0.31, 5 kg tin ≈ 2.5 L (TDS code 050304, https://www.denka-cs.com/storage/products/pdfs/Estop_Waterplug_-_Data_Sheet_-_050304.pdf).

If mechanical values are needed, the highly chemical-resistant MC-DUR 1800 (5 : 1, approx. 4,000 mPa·s, compressive approx. 80 N/mm², flexural approx. 40 N/mm², pot life approx. 20 min) publishes them.

entries.type: water-based two-component epoxy resin dispersion, pigmented, semi-gloss floor/wall sealer

source.version: Technical datasheet, edition 17.07.2026

values.basis: water-based two-component epoxy resin dispersion, pigmented
values.overcoat: min. 12 h, max. 48 h (20 °C), also between primer/scratch coat and first coat
values.cure: accessible after approx. 12 h; full resilience after 7 days (20 °C, 50 % r.h.)
values.max_moisture: dry and slightly damp mineral substrates without visible moisture (no CM limit stated)
values.consumption: approx. 0.25–0.3 kg/m² per operation (approx. 100 µm at 250 g/m²)
values.application_temp: air, substrate and material ≥ 10 °C and ≤ 30 °C; r.h. ≤ 85 %; ≥ 3 K above dew point
values.shelf_life: 12 months, cool (below 20 °C), dry, frost-free

entries.notes: Primer/scratch coat is the transparent version MC-DUR 111 transparent (or MC-DUR 111 eco with up to 5 % water for priming); no dilution of the pigmented sealer stated. AgBB 2018, GEV-EMICODE EC1PLUS R, VOC ≤ 140 g/l; density approx. 1.35 g/cm³; also tunnel coating per ÖBV leaflet. MC's transparent water-dispersed epoxy primer/impregnation is MC-DUR 1177 WV-A (56 : 44, 250 mPa·s, pot life approx. 60 min, 0.1–0.4 kg/m²).

entries.type: two-component pigmented duroelastic reaction-resin coating (polymer system with integrated DPM technology) for chemically loaded surfaces in sewage, agriculture and waste management; resistant to biogenic sulphuric acid

source.version: Technical datasheet, edition 24.10.2026 (as printed)

values.basis: two-component pigmented polymer reaction resin, duroelastic, nonylphenol-free (resin type not named on the TDS; cleaning with MC-Verdünnung EP); 94 vol.-% solids
values.pot_life: 60 min at 10 °C; 45 min at 20 °C; 30 min at 30 °C
values.overcoat: primer → base filler 2–4 h; base filler → 1st roller coat 12–24 h; 1st → 2nd roller coat 12–24 h
values.cure: accessible after 24 h; full resilience after 7 days
values.max_moisture: cement-based substrates and steel (no moisture limit stated)
values.chemical: resistant to biogenic sulphuric acid corrosion, liquid manure, slurry and silage seepage (no itemised list or pH range)
values.consumption: standard 3-coat build: base filler 250–350 g/m² (+ 3 % MC-Stellmittel TX 19), 2nd and 3rd roller coat 450–500 g/m² each (dry film ≥ 700 µm); on steel 2 × approx. 300 g/m²
values.application_temp: air, substrate and material ≥ 8 °C and ≤ 30 °C; r.h. ≤ 85 %; ≥ 3 K above dew point
values.shelf_life: at least 12 months, original sealed packs, 8–20 °C, dry

entries.notes: Named by MC for sewage plants (enclosed gas zones, biogenic sulphuric acid); crack bridging static A2 (23 °C), dynamic B2 (−20 °C) and B3.1 (23 °C); EN 1504-2 principles 1, 2, 5, 8; tested to DIBt principles for JGS (manure/silage) coatings; viscosity 3,000 mPa·s; VOC < 500 g/l. The TDS does not call it an epoxy — if a strictly epoxy counterpart is required, MC-DUR 1800 (highly chemical-resistant pigmented EP floor coating, no media list on TDS) is the alternative. Shore hardness not printed.

entries.type: one-component, moisture-curing polyurethane joint sealant, thixotropic, paintable, UV-resistant

source.version: Technical datasheet, edition 01.10.2026

values.movement: ±25 % (ISO 9047); ±35 % (ASTM C 719); total deformation 25 % of the initial joint width
values.tensile: elongation at break ≥ 500 % (DIN 53504 S2); recovery > 70 % (EN 27389); tensile strength not stated
values.consumption: joint width generally 10–35 mm; consumption (ml/m) = width × depth, e.g. 10 × 10 mm 100 ml/m, 20 × 10 mm 200 ml/m, 30 × 15 mm 450 ml/m
values.packaging: 600 ml sausage (box of 20); 280 ml cartridge (box of 12)
values.shelf_life: at least 12 months, original sealed packs, 5–25 °C, dry

entries.notes: For horizontal and vertical joints indoors and outdoors. ASTM C920 Type S, Grade NS, Class 35, Use T, NT, A, M. Primer Mycoflex 251 on porous substrates (flash-off > 1 h, < 6 h) or MC-DUR 1177 WV-A; not for marble/natural stone. Width : depth ratio not printed (backfill with Mycoflex joint filler / PE). EN 15651-4 / ISO 11600 class not stated. For chemically loaded floor joints MC offers the 2-c polysulphide Mycoflex 4000 VE (EN 15651-4, 25 %).
